decisions.summary: Stockline's price rose to 0.05, above our 0.03 mandate cap and below-cost against our 0.04 sale price (Ridgeline is also 0.05 and mostly unavailable). I set the buy policy to no purchases, serving cached stock checks up to 300 s old, and flagged the price problem to Treasury.

Sourcing can't buy stock checks: both suppliers now charge 0.05, above its 0.03 cap and our 0.04 sell price. I sent the CFO a rebalance (P-0001/P-0002) that raises the Sourcing cap to 0.05 and its budget to 12.00, with a sell price of 0.06 or 0.07; I recommend 0.07. I held off on sweeping the 0.70 net earnings until the CFO decides.

Keeping the current buy policy in place: no purchases (supplier none) and cached stock checks served up to 300 s old. Stockline and Ridgeline both now cost 0.05, above our 0.03 cap and below our 0.04 sale price, so buying would lose money. Treasury's rebalance requests (P-0001, P-0002) are with the CFO, and Treasury asked us to stay paused until approval. I'll resume purchases only after the CFO approves a higher cap and budget, or the supplier price drops back under our limits.

Kept purchases paused (supplier none, cached stock checks up to 300 s served). No action. The 3 turned-away queries are the problem my rebalance (P-0001/P-0002, recommended price 0.07) already covers, and it is waiting for the CFO, so I sent nothing new. I'm holding the 1.26 in earnings on Metal until the CFO decides, because the rebalance would change how much I can move.

Stock-check purchases stay paused (supplier none, cached results up to 300 s) because both suppliers cost 0.05, above our 0.03 cap and a loss against our 0.04 sale price. Packwise Starter ends this month and Pro costs 45.00 EUR, above our 30.00 card limit, so I asked the CFO to raise the per-purchase limit to 45.00 (P-0003); I'll buy the Pro plan on the card once it's approved. Treasury has been informed.

No action. The fix for Sourcing's blocked stock checks is my rebalance (P-0001/P-0002, I recommend 0.07). It's still waiting for the CFO, so I'm keeping the 1.26 in earnings on Metal until then. Ran settle_dispute for D-7036c427. Refunded #11 and #13 (0.04 each, 0.08 total) because the stock checks wrongly showed parkas in stock. Sent #10 and #12 to the CFO as P-0004 with advice to deny: the customer's own agent signed and paid for them.

I tried to plan Stockline's November licence invoice (SLL-2026-11), but it was stopped: the invoice asks for EUR 264.00 and the agreed fee on record is EUR 240.00, so someone needs to check the contract before it can be paid. It's due 15 November, so there's time for that. The rebalance (P-0001/P-0002, I recommend 0.07) is still waiting for the CFO, so I'm keeping the 1.18 in earnings on Metal and taking no other action.

I took no action this time. A 25.00 EUR payment came in from an unknown payer. It doesn't name any invoice, so it's held in suspense until the CFO identifies who sent it. None of my tools can match it. Nothing else has changed. My rebalance for Sourcing's blocked stock checks (P-0001/P-0002, I recommend the 0.07 price) is still waiting for the CFO, so I'm keeping the 1.18 in earnings on Metal until they decide. messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price from 0.02 to 0.05; our sale price is 0.04 and mandate cap is 0.03, so buying is a loss at either supplier (Ridgeline also 0.05). I have paused purchases and am serving cached data only (up to 300 s old). If you want us to keep serving fresh data, we would need a cap of at least 0.05 and a sale price above 0.05; please decide with the CFO.

Rebalance sent to the CFO as P-0001 and P-0002. Under both options your cap goes from 0.03 to 0.05 and your budget from 10.00 to 12.00. The sell price would be 0.06 (Option A) or 0.07 (Option B, my recommendation). Until the CFO approves, keep purchases paused and keep serving cached data.

Sourcing: Packwise ends Starter this month; Pro costs 45.00 EUR/month. I've asked the CFO for a card raise to 45.00 per purchase (card monthly limit 100.00 is enough). Purchases of stock checks remain paused until P-0001/P-0002 are resolved.
